The '''Travnin system''' was a double-[[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained only one planet, a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]], around which the wind-swept [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Travnin/Legends|Travnin]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]].
